review_grain: One retained source reviewer-product record joined to one parent listing; user_id + parent_asin + timestamp is not asserted unique.

rules.duplicates: SHA-256 of sorted-key canonical JSON of ALL raw fields including images; keep first source occurrence. No deletion for repeated IDs.
rules.text: Preserve originals; derived text strips outer whitespace, blank to null; preserve case, punctuation, HTML, interior whitespace and encoding. Never normalize IDs.
rules.price: Preserve raw; strip outer whitespace, None/empty to null; numeric parse failures flagged; negative/nonfinite to null and flagged; zero and >1000 retained and flagged.
rules.store: Null stays null; flag missing; no deletion; store is not assumed brand.
rules.timestamp: Preserve epoch milliseconds; UTC derived time; flag missing, failed, and outside May 1996 through September 2023.
rules.validation: Derived rating integer 1-5, helpful vote nonnegative integer, verified purchase actual boolean; otherwise null and flag.
rules.content: Retain arrays and details raw; ordered newline text; parsed details serialized as JSON; empty captured containers mean absent usable content.
rules.merge: Metadata parent_asin nonnull and unique; left many-to-one; retain all metadata products.
rules.metrics: Valid denominators; price mean at unique product grain; dropna=False grouping; helpful sums min_count=1.
rules.sample: 50 rows: retained predefined cases, duplicate counterpart 6566, first observed flags, remaining deterministic random seed 576.
